name: RunKit
caveats: Service offline (checked live 2026-09-29): runkit.com, runkit.io, embed.runkit.com and tonicdev.com all return HTTP 503 from the AWS load balancer, the runkit.com TLS certificate expired 2026-01-18, and discuss.runkit.com/status.runkit.com do not answer. Wayback shows the last HTTP 200 of runkit.com/home on 2025-10-14 and 503 from 2026-01-12 onward. No official shutdown notice was found; blog.runkit.com last post is 2018-12-10 and the runkitdev GitHub org was last pushed 2023-12. RunKit (ex-Tonic, YC S16) was acquired by Stripe. It never published a paid tariff: it was a free Node.js notebook, Embed and Endpoint (beta, non-commercial) service.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

Historic limits, from the archived official docs (Wayback 2025-10-18, not live): RunKit Endpoint was a beta. 'Requests must terminate within 60 seconds. Endpoints are rate limited, and during the beta period they are restricted to non-commercial use.' Commercial use or higher limits were by contact only. No price was ever published.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

status: offline: all domains HTTP 503 since 2026-01 and TLS certificate expired; no official shutdown notice (treat as discontinued)

harness_api.note: Node.js notebook/Embed/Endpoint service (2015-2025) predating coding-agent harnesses; no agent features. Service offline.
